usedFor: Agendor holds deals and people, and “Deal Stage Updated” can drive “Update Spreadsheet Row” in the Google Sheets row.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Stage Updated” in Agendor, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each stage change updates the columns of a sheet row, so the sheet follows the pipeline.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits an existing row, so a “New Person” run changes a row instead of adding one.
